import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { FlightSearchService, LayoverConnection, FlightInfo } from '../../services/search.service'; import { TicketsService } from '../../services/tickets.service'; // Assicurati di avere questo service! import { UserHttpService } from '../../user-http.service'; // Per recuperare il token se serve import { Router } from '@angular/router'; @Component({ selector: 'app-search', templateUrl: './search.component.html', styleUrls: ['./search.component.css'] }) export class FlightSearchComponent { depart: string = ''; destination: string = ''; dataOra: string = ''; loading = false; errorMessage = ''; directFlights: FlightInfo[] = []; layoverConnections: LayoverConnection[] = []; constructor( private flightSearchService: FlightSearchService, private ticketsService: TicketsService, private us: UserHttpService, private router: Router) {} /*search() { this.errorMessage = ''; this.loading = true; this.directFlights = []; this.layoverConnections = []; this.flightSearchService.searchFlights(this.depart, this.destination, this.dataOra).subscribe({ next: (results) => { console.log("Ricerca avvenuta"); this.loading = false; if(results.length === 0){ this.errorMessage = 'Nessun volo trovato'; return; } if ('firstLeg' in results[0]) { // Sono connessioni con scalo this.layoverConnections = results as LayoverConnection[]; } else { // Sono voli diretti this.directFlights = results as FlightInfo[]; } }, error: (err) => { this.loading = false; this.errorMessage = err.error?.errormessage || 'Errore durante la ricerca voli.'; } }); }*/ getMinSeatPrice(seats: any[]): number { if (!seats || seats.length === 0) return Infinity; return Math.min(...seats.map(seat => this.getSeatPrice(seat))); } getMinLayoverPrice(conn: LayoverConnection): number { const minFirstLeg = this.getMinSeatPrice(conn.firstLeg.seats); const minSecondLeg = this.getMinSeatPrice(conn.secondLeg.seats); return minFirstLeg + minSecondLeg; } // Ordina voli diretti per prezzo minimo posto sortDirectFlights() { this.directFlights.sort( (a, b) => this.getMinSeatPrice(a.seats) - this.getMinSeatPrice(b.seats) ); } // Ordina connessioni con scalo per somma minima prezzi posti sortLayoverConnections() { this.layoverConnections.sort( (a, b) => this.getMinLayoverPrice(a) - this.getMinLayoverPrice(b) ); } search() { this.errorMessage = ''; this.loading = true; this.directFlights = []; this.layoverConnections = []; this.flightSearchService.searchFlights(this.depart, this.destination, this.dataOra).subscribe({ next: (results) => { this.loading = false; if (results.length === 0) { this.errorMessage = 'Nessun volo trovato'; return; } if ('firstLeg' in results[0]) { // Connessioni con scalo this.layoverConnections = results as LayoverConnection[]; this.sortLayoverConnections(); } else { // Voli diretti this.directFlights = results as FlightInfo[]; this.sortDirectFlights(); } }, error: (err) => { this.loading = false; this.errorMessage = err.error?.errormessage || 'Errore durante la ricerca voli.'; } }); } getSeatPrice(seat: any): number { if (!seat || !seat.class) return 0; const cls = seat.class.toLowerCase(); if (cls.includes('economy')) return 10; if (cls.includes('business')) return 30; if (cls.includes('first')) return 50; return 20; // default } acquistaVolo(flight: FlightInfo, seat: any) { console.log("Acquisto volo, ID:", flight.flightCode, "Oggetto:", flight); if (!seat || !seat._numSeat) { alert('Dati del posto non validi.'); return; } const ticketData = { flight: flight.flightCode, seat: seat._numSeat || '', price: this.getSeatPrice(seat) || 0, numBag: 0 }; const token = this.us.get_token(); console.log("[DEBUG] Token presente?", !!token); if (!token) { localStorage.setItem('pendingTicket', JSON.stringify(ticketData)); console.log("Salvato pendingTicket:", ticketData); this.router.navigate(['/login']); return; } console.log("[DEBUG] Ticket diretto, pronto al post:", ticketData); if (this.us.is_passenger()) { this.ticketsService.addTickets(ticketData).subscribe({ next: (res) => { console.log("Biglietto acquistato per volo ID:", ticketData.flight, "Response:", res); alert('Biglietto acquistato con successo!'); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Errore acquisto biglietto:', err); alert('Errore durante l\'acquisto del biglietto.'); } }); } } acquistaEntrambiVoli(conn: LayoverConnection, seat1 : any, seat2: any) { if (!seat1?._numSeat || !seat2?._numSeat) { alert('Posti non validi.'); return; } const firstTicket = { flight: conn.firstLeg.flightCode, seat: seat1._numSeat || '', price: conn.firstLeg.price || 0, numBag: 0 }; const secondTicket = { flight: conn.secondLeg.flightCode, seat: seat2._numSeat || '', price: conn.secondLeg.price || 0, numBag: 0 }; console.log("[DEBUG] Acquisto con scalo - firstTicket:", firstTicket); console.log("[DEBUG] Acquisto con scalo - secondTicket:", secondTicket); const token = this.us.get_token(); if(!token){ localStorage.setItem('pendingLayoverTickets', JSON.stringify([firstTicket, secondTicket])); console.log("[DEBUG] pendingLayoverTickets salvati:", [firstTicket, secondTicket]); this.router.navigate(['/login']); return; } if(this.us.is_passenger()){ console.log("Arrivato"); this.ticketsService.addTickets(firstTicket).subscribe({ next: () => { this.ticketsService.addTickets(secondTicket).subscribe({ next: () => { alert('Entrambi i voli acquistati con successo!'); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Errore durante l\'acquisto del secondo volo:', err); alert('Primo volo acquistato, ma errore sul secondo.'); } }); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Errore durante l\'acquisto del primo volo:', err); alert('Errore durante l\'acquisto del primo volo.'); } }); } } }
